fields.value: CASA MILA (Cultural and Social Aspects of Multimodal Interaction on Language Acquisition) data

dsDescriptionValue.value:
Annotated and analysed data from observations carried out within the CASA MILA project. The observations concerned natural multimodal interactions of infants (aged 13-18 months) from three different cultural communities (in the Netherlands, rural Mozambique and urban Mozambique).
Focus of the analysis concerned verbal and non-verbal communication in three cultural learning environments.

publicationCitation.value: Vogt, P., Mastin, J., Masson-Carro, I., & de Jong, C. (2020, August 17). Multimodal interactions among infants in three radically different learning environments. Retrieved from psyarxiv.com/xfkag

fields.value:
Method: Natural longitudinal observations in the field.
Universe: 12 Dutch infants (and their caregivers). 
14 rural Mozambican infants (and their caregivers). 
14 urban Mozambican infants (and their caregivers). 
Age range 13-18 months old.

datasetVersion.citation: Vogt, Paul; Mastin, J. Douglas; Masson-Carro, Ingrid, 2020, "CASA MILA (Cultural and Social Aspects of Multimodal Interaction on Language Acquisition) data", https://doi.org/10.34894/YQDSTG, DataverseNL, V1
